sampling: Train byte-identical to v1; within each original held-out split, sha256(seed, sample_id) selects equal call/no_call counts; valid 100+100, test 95+95
noncall_scoring: evaluate presence/absence of a structured call only; no text correctness claim
arguments_normalization: JSON object key order only; preserve value types, array order, case and string format
unavailable_tools_subset: requires explicit reviewed annotation; otherwise denominator zero and N/A
clarification_subset: no source gold label; do not automatically infer from a question mark
schema: Draft7 plus installed FormatChecker; honor additionalProperties as declared; no added restrictions or remote refs
checkpoint_selection: Validation strict match, then reviewed unavailable-tools false-call rate if defined, then earlier update
test_status: frozen IDs only; no model evaluation until T4
distribution: balanced diagnostic, not original population distribution
user_approval: 2026-10-22: adopt balanced sampling before any formal model evaluation
